title: BOMBANANA!
genre: 3-player online co-op party game / asymmetric-communication bomb defusal (the three monkeys are 'blind, deaf and mute', i.e. see-, hear- and speak-no-evil), in the spirit of Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
release_date: 2026-09-02 (Steam, PC) [CONFIRMED – Steam store page / publisher press release on Game Developer]
early_access_date: n/a (full release; free demo from ~June 2026 Steam Next Fest)
window_note: In window (Next Fest demo June 2026, launch 2026-09-02). Placed in GROUP C (context case), not B, because the team size could not be confirmed as ≤5 after 6 searches. The founder calls it a 'small independent team', but it is publisher-financed (TARK Games).
developer: Lefto Studio (founder Ufuk Girit, 25 at founding)
team_size: no data – not published in any source found; described as a 'small independent team' [CONFIRMED – Ufuk Girit quote via Turkish press (Chip, Haber Hürriyeti)]
country: Türkiye (Istanbul) [CONFIRMED – publisher press release datelined Istanbul; GamesBeat/Mobidictum]
developer_background: BOMBANANA! is Lefto Studio's first commercial game [CONFIRMED – publisher press release on Game Developer]. Team members previously worked on similar co-op party games, including Liar's Bar and We Are So Cooked [per press-release summary; roles not specified]. Publisher TARK Games was founded in Istanbul in 2025 by İlker Ergen and İbrahim Yıldırım. It raised $2.5M (led by Ludus Ventures), takes no studio equity and provides development financing, production, player research, marketing and creator relations [CONFIRMED – TARK via GamesBeat/Mobidictum].
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656000/BOMBANANA/ ; Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4747510/BOMBANANA_Demo/ ; Roblox adaptation (built by FXFX Studio, Tallinn, with Lefto/TARK): https://rowatcher.com/games/10753487407/bombanana ; mobile version announced for later [CONFIRMED – Co-Optimus/80.lv]
business_model: Premium $7.99, launch discount 38% to $4.95 until 2026-09-09 [CONFIRMED – Steam store / Co-Optimus]. A multi-copy bundle ('BananaUp' pack) is listed on gg.deals, which suggests friend packs; contents not verified. Free demo kept live. Separate official Roblox experience (F2P).
units_or_downloads: Paid copies: 500,000 in 3 days [CONFIRMED – Lefto/TARK via Chip.com.tr]; >1,000,000 copies in first 10 days on PC, announced 2026-09-22 [CONFIRMED – Lefto Studio via Insider Gaming, GamesBeat, Mobidictum]. Inven Global's headline instead says '1 million players in two weeks' (see conflicts). ~110,000 copies, ~$703k gross as of ~2026-10-04 [ESTIMATE – Raijin, medium confidence]. Boxleiter cross-check: 3,547 reviews × 60 (cheap viral co-op bought for 3-player groups) ≈ 213,000 (range ×40–100: 142k–355k) [ESTIMATE]. 99% of sales came from outside Türkiye [CONFIRMED – Girit/TARK via Turkish press]. Demo: 675,000+ Next Fest players; 6,000,000+ demo players by launch [CONFIRMED – Lefto/TARK]. Wishlists: 230k+ during Next Fest; >1,000,000 before launch; +300,000 new wishlists after launch [CONFIRMED – Lefto/TARK]. Roblox adaptation: 13M visits/50k favorites, later 16M visits/80k favorites [CONFIRMED – TARK] vs 3.7M visits [ESTIMATE – RoWatcher].
peak_concurrent_players: Paid game: 17,000+ within ~2 days of launch [ESTIMATE – SteamDB via 80.lv]; 21,294 on 2026-09-04 [ESTIMATE – SteamDB via Univers Simu]; 22,811 all-time [ESTIMATE – Raijin, ~2026-10-04]. Demo: 30,000+ during Next Fest, ~31,000 on the final fest day (June 2026) [CONFIRMED – Lefto via Univers Simu / secondary].
steam_reviews: 3,547 reviews, 96% positive (~2026-10-04) [Raijin]; 3,225, 96% (Steam store snapshot, late Sept 2026); 'Overwhelmingly Positive'. Demo: 1,395 reviews, 97% positive.
implied_review_multiplier: If the developer's 1,000,000 copies (2026-09-12) is set against ≤3,225–3,547 reviews (counted later, so the true figure at day 10 was lower), the implied ratio is ≥280×. That is an extreme outlier, roughly 3–5× above even mega-viral friendslop (60–100×). Raijin's 110k implies ~31×. The developer figure probably includes multi-pack/gifted copies (non-reviewing friends) or counts players; treat 280× as unreliable.
gross_revenue: [ESTIMATE] Three scenarios. (a) Developer claim: 1M copies × ~$4.50 average realised price (most sold at the $4.95 launch discount, plus regional pricing and packs) ≈ $4.5M by 2026-09-12. (b) Boxleiter: ~213k × ~$5.00 ≈ $1.1M by early Oct 2026. (c) Raijin: $703k (2026-10-04). Working figure: $1M–$4.5M gross in the first month.
net_revenue: [ESTIMATE] Gross × 0.70 (Steam cut) × 0.93 (refunds): (a) ≈ $2.9M; (b) ≈ $0.7M; (c) ≈ $0.46M. The Lefto/TARK split is not disclosed. TARK financed development, so a sizeable publisher share is likely. Roblox adaptation revenue is not disclosed.
production_cost: no data disclosed. [ESTIMATE, assumption-heavy] If the team was 3–8 people for ~12 months at ~$3k/person-month (Türkiye), the cost would be ~$110k–$290k plus publisher marketing and creator relations. Team size and development time are unverified.
why_popular: One-sentence hook: three monkeys, one blind, one deaf, one mute, must defuse a bomb together. Asymmetric handicaps force chaotic voice, gesture and pointing communication that is funny to play and to watch. Session-based, cheap ($4.95 at launch), and needs exactly 3 friends, so one buyer pulls in two more. It is easy to understand but produces different moments each run (Girit). It is also a highly clip-able spectator format: 1M+ hours watched on Twitch [CONFIRMED – Lefto].
marketing_channels: Steam Next Fest June 2026: the #1 most-played demo on Valve's unique-player list, with the most new wishlists of any game (Alinea). Free demo kept live after the fest (6M+ players), turning players into wishlists (>1M). Publisher creator-relations push: 1M+ Twitch hours watched. Release-date announcement timed to the 1M-wishlist milestone. Launch discount. Turkish national press coverage. Official Roblox adaptation to extend the IP to younger audiences. TikTok role not verified.
art_style: Stylised cartoon 3D monkeys; bright, readable party-game look [qualitative from press screenshots/descriptions; 2D vs 3D not formally confirmed]
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write the bomb-module puzzle logic, randomised rule generation, Steam lobby/P2P networking boilerplate, UI and localisation (Claude Code); produce stylised low-poly monkey models and props (Meshy/Tripo plus manual cleanup), SFX (ElevenLabs) and music (Suno). | AI cannot: design the asymmetric-handicap communication loop that makes it funny, tune puzzle difficulty for 3 people, run many group playtests, rig/animate expressive characters to a polished bar, or recreate the Next Fest plus publisher creator-relations machine behind 6M demo players. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity (Netcode/Fishnet + Steamworks.NET) or Godot 4 + GodotSteam, Meshy/Tripo + Mixamo for animation, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno music. Score 4: simple 3D plus light peer-hosted 3-player multiplayer, with modest content.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: [ESTIMATE – spec method] 4–8 weeks, $250–$700 (Claude Pro/Max, 3D gen, audio subscriptions, $100 Steam Direct fee); excludes the developer's living costs
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: [ESTIMATE – spec method] 3–6 months, $2,500–$8,000 (subscriptions, asset packs, freelance character animation polish, playtest/Next Fest/creator outreach budget); excludes the developer's living costs. Matching Bombanana's reach would additionally need a publisher-level creator campaign.

data_conflicts: 1) Units: developer says 1M+ copies in 10 days (2026-09-22) and 500k in 3 days. Raijin estimates ~110k (2026-10-04). Reviews (≤3.5k) imply ~140k–355k with normal multipliers. Inven Global's headline says '1 million players'. The developer number is reported as CONFIRMED-claimed, but it looks inflated relative to reviews; it probably counts pack, gifted or key copies or players. Gross revenue is given as a $1M–$4.5M range. 2) Peak CCU: 17k (2 days, SteamDB via 80.lv), 21,294 (2026-09-04, SteamDB via Univers Simu) and 22,811 (Raijin all-time); 22,811 is used as the latest all-time figure. 3) Next Fest players: 675k (developer) vs >1M (Venn Studios). 4) Roblox visits: 13M→16M (TARK) vs 3.7M (RoWatcher). 5) Earlier coverage gave release dates of 15 June / August; the Steam store and press release confirm 2026-09-02.
notes: Group C = context case: team size could not be verified (described only as a 'small independent team' with publisher TARK financing), and the developer's 1M-copies claim conflicts with tracker estimates (~110k) and a very low review count (~3.5k). Kept for its Next Fest lesson.  Lessons for a solo creator: (1) A one-line asymmetric co-op hook (each player has a different handicap) is extremely streamable and drives organic sharing. (2) A free Next Fest demo kept live after the fest can snowball: 6M demo players → 1M+ wishlists. (3) Paid conversion is much weaker than demo hype: 22.8k paid peak vs ~31k demo peak, and only ~3.5k reviews a month after launch despite 1M+ wishlists. This is consistent with the 0.10–0.15× wishlist-to-week-1 benchmark if units are ~110k–215k. (4) A publisher (TARK) supplied financing, creator relations and a Roblox adaptation; a solo developer would have to replace that with their own streamer outreach.
